history_summary: Correct Wetland consortium labels and Enterococcus stock identity while retaining roster and graph limitations.
history_details: The source Methods distinguish top-down enrichment Y13 from bottom-up consortium M. Four scalar corrections separate R12/E. casseliflavus from PseS3/E. avium and R1/R3/E. thailandicus, and distinguish sediment MAG bin436 from isolate R12. One open discussion retains six exact source quotations documenting treatment identity, incomplete membership and unverified stock-specific revival. The five original taxon terms, GTDB states, functional roles, existing source quotations, three interaction nodes, two arrows and earlier history are unchanged. This identity-only intermediate does not resolve full membership under issue2898 or the separate pceA, syntrophy and methane causal findings under issue2899. No new strain accession, study-genome placement, mechanism or scientific approval is inferred. A subsequent mapping transition must bind this actual corrected source-identity record.
